completedStages.name: vision-and-loop
completedStages.summary: The game is an exploration-plus-cell-editor loop; evolution that changes abilities and play is the primary way to surpass the reference. One numbered iteration means one distinct batch of changes, whether or not its check is complete; push after iterations 3, 6, and 9, then stop and wait.

completedStages.name: play-experience
completedStages.summary: Landscape-first mobile browser game; steer with a virtual joystick and use action buttons; target 5–8 minute expeditions, returning to the cell editor at major growth milestones.

completedStages.name: presentation-and-scope
completedStages.summary: Use a slot-based cell editor where organs have real gameplay trade-offs; include a first-biome food web with nutrients, prey, and predators; use an original semi-realistic microscope visual direction.
